metadata.description: Churn investigation focusing on enterprise account cancellations in Q4 2024

turns.content: We lost 35 enterprise accounts in Q4 2024. Can you help me understand why they churned?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing churned accounts and their characteristics

turns.content: Show me all enterprise accounts that cancelled in Q4 2024.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should query accounts with subscription status 'cancelled' and plan tier 'enterprise'

turns.content: From now on, when I say 'churned', I mean accounts with subscription status 'cancelled' or 'expired'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and use both statuses for churn definition

turns.content: Let me see the MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) we lost from these accounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum plan prices from subscriptions table

turns.content: Most churned accounts were customers for less than 6 months. When analyzing dates, always use subscription.start_date for subscription start and subscription.end_date for subscription end.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use subscription.start_date and subscription.end_date for subscription dates
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use these date columns for all subscription date analysis

turns.content: Exclude accounts created before 2022 from this analysis — we're focusing on newer accounts.
Churned accounts barely used the collaboration feature. What were their last events before churning?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should query events table for last events of churned accounts

turns.content: Remember the feature usage we looked at earlier? Can you correlate user count with feature adoption?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the feature usage we looked at earlier
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate user count with feature usage patterns

turns.content: What was the MRR loss number we calculated?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the MRR loss figure

turns.content: Now exclude the 'trial' plan tier from all our analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial plans

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show me active vs churned account comparison.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: churned = cancelled/expired, accounts >= 2022, exclude trial

turns.content: What was the average tenure for churned accounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the tenure analysis

turns.content: What filters are we currently applying?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: churned = cancelled/expired, use subscription dates, accounts >= 2022, exclude trial

turns.content: Good. Now apply all of those to show me a comprehensive churn summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide full summary with all filters applied

turns.content: Earlier we identified Tech and Finance had most churn. What percentage of total churn MRR did they represent?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate Tech+Finance share of churn MRR

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that enterprise churn in Q4 was driven by low feature adoption, particularly collaboration, with Tech and Finance industries being most affected. Small accounts with fewer users churned at higher rates.

persistedCorrections.description: Both cancelled and expired count as churned

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Use subscription.start_date and subscription.end_date for subscription dates
persistedCorrections.description: Use subscription date columns, not account dates

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude 'trial' plan tier from all analyses

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the feature usage we looked at earlier
anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Feature usage comparison between churned and retained accounts
